decisions.reason: The organic poultry mini salami builds on the firm's salami and curing know-how and supports its organic direction, but the snack format already lost Product C and it has no visible fresh promotion, so the risk is moderate.

Organic Fleischwurst rests squarely on the firm's traditional cooked-sausage expertise and its organic expansion, so the firm can read early results and adjust recipes with knowledge it already holds.

The thinly sliced organic chicken breast line in several flavours extends established slicing and seasoning capabilities into a growing ingredient-conscious segment, giving enough related knowledge to learn and refine it, though poultry is somewhat less core.

The organic herb-coated salami draws directly on in-house seasoning and maturation skills, but the earlier withdrawal of the organic salami platter suggests some overlap risk within the organic salami assortment.
